title: AWS Certified Developer - Associate (DVA-C02)
summary: AWS Certified Developer - Associate (DVA-C02) is an associate-level certification for practitioners who build and operate on AWS. The exam is organised into 4 content domains: Development with AWS Services (32%), Security (26%), Deployment (24%), Troubleshooting and Optimization (18%). It is delivered as 50 scored questions and 15 unscored, scored against a scaled pass mark of 720 out of 1,000 with no per-domain minimum, so strength in one domain offsets weakness in another. Every task statement in this topic carries a MEDIUM and a HARD exercise batch, so the practice material follows the published outline of the exam rather than a general reading list. The statements here are taken from the exam guide, and the task list is the one AWS publishes: if AWS revises the guide, this topic is revised with it.
objectives: Development with AWS Services: the guide's domain 1 focus, examined through its 3 task statement(s).
Security: the guide's domain 2 focus, examined through its 3 task statement(s).
Deployment: the guide's domain 3 focus, examined through its 4 task statement(s).
Troubleshooting and Optimization: the guide's domain 4 focus, examined through its 3 task statement(s).
